involves.heading: What Generator Service Involves
involves.body: Home generator installation starts with sizing the unit to your home's electrical load, then involves connecting it to a transfer switch so it kicks in automatically during an outage. Generator repair covers everything from a unit that won't start to one that's running but not producing reliable power, and regular maintenance catches small issues before they turn into a generator that fails during the outage it's meant for. Carolina Heating Service provides:
bullets: Whole house generator installation sized to your home's electrical needs
Generator repair for units that won't start or aren't running reliably
Standby generator maintenance to keep your unit ready for the next outage
Generator installation for new construction or as a backup power upgrade

signs.heading: Signs You Need Generator Repair
signs.body: A generator that won't start during a test or an actual outage, runs but doesn't produce steady power, or shows a fault code on its display are all reasons to have it inspected. Unusual noises, visible fuel or oil leaks, or a battery that keeps dying are also signs of a problem. Because most generator issues surface during testing rather than an emergency, regular maintenance is what catches these problems before you actually need the generator to work.
